chunks: Do they feel secure that an all-encompassing punishment of God will not come upon them, or that the Hour will come upon them suddenly while they are unaware?
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God asks 'Do they feel secure?' regarding sudden punishment?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Yusuf, this verse highlights the psychological state of those who, despite witnessing divine signs, remain complacent in their heedlessness. It serves as a rhetorical challenge to the disbelievers, emphasizing the unpredictability of divine retribution and the suddenness of the Hour, which catches the unaware off guard. This reinforces the Shia scholarly emphasis on *yaqazah* (spiritual wakefulness) as a necessary counter to the illusion of safety in worldly life.
